text.tspan: Lookup goes OUTWARD only. A closure is the link that survives after the outer call returns.
Lookup never goes inward: the outer scope cannot see anything
declared inside, and two sibling scopes cannot see each other.
The makeCounter() frame is gone from the stack,
but the returned function still holds its scope link,
so count is kept alive and stays private.
Every call to the outer function makes a NEW scope, so a and b
capture two independent counts. That is how closures give you
